source_commit_note: Measured at HEAD 9bc9c387 on branch staging over a working tree that carried the PFP-73 divstep-domain restriction, its four tests (three in src/bn/blinding.rs, one in src/bn/divstep/tests.rs), and the 0.0.51 version bump. That exact tree is committed as the 0.0.51 release commit, so 2,610 is the count of the release tree, not a dirty-worktree artefact. The earlier 2,606 figure described the tree before those four tests existed. A previous revision of this note said clean HEAD would be 2,606; that was true only until the tests were committed, and is superseded.
source_tree_unchanged_note: False by construction. The measured tree is HEAD 9bc9c387 plus uncommitted src/bn work (4 added tests) and the 0.0.51 release-metadata bump; the source-tree digest recorded in atlas-refresh/build-0.0.51.json binds the exact bytes this run used. It is not a clean-commit measurement, and no commit is claimed to contain these bytes.
note: Current record: 2,610 passed / 0 failed / 56 ignored / 2,666 total (0 measured, 0 filtered out) from `cargo test --lib -- --test-threads=4` in the court container (OPENSSL_RS_COURT_MEM=6g, CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2, CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0). The 2,231/0/52 record at cc7762e5d and the older 1,962/0/42 floor are superseded. The expected clean-HEAD figure for this release was 2,606 passed / 0 failed / 56 ignored; the observed 2,610 includes the four pre-existing uncommitted bn tests described above.
